name: 32bit-to-64bit-app-migration
description: Rehost a 32-bit ARM game or app inside a 64-bit process — feasibility, bring-up, interpreter correctness, frame optimisation, and shipping.

plugins.name: rehost
plugins.description: Run an unmodified 32-bit ARM binary inside a 64-bit app: measure the seam, bring it up headless, prove the interpreter, port the hot guest functions to the host until the frame budget holds, and ship it without breaking saves.
